Definition: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Bene-Jaakan means "sons of twisting." It was an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as H0885). It turns up in Numbers 33:31 and Numbers 33:32.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bene-Jaakan matters because the land itself is part of the promise.
